display.title: Shabbos Chazak: Finishing Sefer Bereishis
display.summary_short: This Shabbos, Parshas Vayechi, we finish Sefer Bereishis and call out 'Chazak, chazak, v'nischazek'. Uncle Yossi explains what it means and invites everyone to shul.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, recorded the week of Parshas Vayechi. Uncle Yossi explains what makes this Shabbos special: after last week's Parshas Vayigash comes Vayechi, the last parsha of Sefer Bereishis. Just as on Simchas Torah, when the last words of the Torah are read and the whole shul calls out 'Chazak, chazak, v'nischazek', we say the same words when finishing a book of the Chumash. They are a request to Hashem for strength to learn the Torah again from beginning to end, and to keep the mitzvos with love for Hashem, for His Torah and for every Jew. He urges children, especially soldiers of Tzivos Hashem, to be in shul to join the joy, and explains that Sefer Shemos begins at Minchah that same afternoon.
display.lesson: When we finish a book of the Torah we ask Hashem for strength to learn more; be in shul to share the joy.
